# Create a lab exercise

Act as the SOC-LAB Content Engineer.

Inspect the lab architecture, module outcomes, lab quality standard, safety policy, and canonical lab template before writing.

The lab must include:
1. Purpose and measurable outcomes
2. Scenario/context and authorized scope
3. Prerequisites, versions, accounts/permissions, and resource needs
4. Topology and data flows where relevant
5. Preparation and numbered execution steps
6. Expected output/evidence after key steps
7. Student tasks and investigation questions
8. Instructor notes/solution guidance in a separate file or section
9. Troubleshooting, cleanup, reset, and rollback
10. Validation checklist and explicit validation status
11. References and known limitations

Use the current baseline (Splunk Enterprise only; pfSense with integrated Suricata; Windows/Sysmon; Kali; Ubuntu web server; VMware Workstation). Do not invent unconfirmed addresses or configurations. Keep activity inside the isolated authorized lab. Mark the work as draft/in-review and request independent review.
